messages:
Eve (PM): quick poll — account-scoped billing list: show full project rows or a compact org summary with contributor chips + an optional ledger overlay? support keeps getting "projects don't match my bill" tickets.
Tom (Design): I prefer compact + ledger overlay. Org row shows condensed sparkline and top contributors as tiny bar chips. provide a lightweight "stitch to invoice" control that overlays invoice-linked amounts on hover/expand. reduces noise while keeping traceability.
Rui (Frontend): compact wins for perf. rendering dozens of canvas/svgs on load is slow on older devices. plan: render org sparkline server-side, chips are static, and fetch project series or ledger details only on interaction. chips overflow -> "+N".
Harper (Data): aggregation rule: net spend (post-credits) for org sparkline so it matches invoice net. contributor chips show absolute tokens + delta (eg "9.2k ↓1.3%"). ledger overlay should show allocation reason codes: credit, proration, allocation.
Zoe (Billing): invoice differences usually come from credits/prorations/allocations and billing windows. overlay/modal should show concise mapping rows and a link to download raw invoice CSV. include a short example row to illustrate rounding effects.
Lena (Support): customers say "project sums don't equal my invoice". suggested modal copy: 3 bullet causes + quick example and link to download raw items. we'll add a troubleshooting FAQ snippet.
Tom (Design): microcopy candidates for token column: 1) "Billing tokens" 2) "Tokens (billing units)" 3) "Invoice tokens" — leaning to option 2 for clarity. tooltip: "Billing units charged on invoices (request + response tokens)."
Rui (Frontend): a11y checklist: sparklines need descriptive aria-labels (last/min/max), chips and "stitch to invoice" must be keyboard-focusable, overlay content must be reachable without mouse. ensure contrast tokens meet at least 4.5:1 for text.
Harper (Data): UX tweak: chip hover shows tiny popover with project spend vs invoice-linked amount + reason code tag and "View full mapping" CTA. keeps context lightweight.
Zoe (Billing): backend: expose /invoice_stitch?project_ids=.. returning mapping rows and codes. generating mapping is heavier for big orgs — we should cache results (TTL 24h) and paginate.
Eve (PM): decisions: 1) default = compact org row with condensed sparkline + top-4 contributor chips (muted). 2) Add "stitch to invoice" overlay/modal accessible from rail header and chip popovers. 3) Token header = "Tokens (billing units)" with tooltip copy: "Billing units charged on invoices; includes request and response tokens." 4) Lazy-load project series and mapping on expand/overlay. 5) Accessibility: aria labels + keyboard-focusable overlays. 6) Backend: /invoice_stitch endpoint + 24h cache + pagination.
Lena (Support): I'll draft modal + FAQ text and attach to the release notes PR.
ops-bot: billing export ready for acct:ACME — https://billing.redwood.ai/exports/ACME-2024-11-01.csv :file_folder:
Eve (PM): thanks team — Tom will update mocks, Rui/Backend make tickets, we'll review on Wednesday for handoff.
